page.content:
Switchblade who led Bullet Club after the Elite departed.

How Jay White connects

  • Faction: Bullet Club — Jay White led Bullet Club's Switchblade chapter in New Japan.
  • Character: Kazuchika Okada — Jay White's Switchblade run was built on feuds with Okada.

What is Jay White?

Jay White, the Switchblade, took Bullet Club's Tokyo chapter after Omega and the Bucks left, holding the IWGP Heavyweight Championship and feuding with Okada and Tanahashi.

Key threads lead to Bullet Club and Kazuchika Okada.
